meta.name: earn-trust
meta.description: Plan how to earn customer trust and appropriate access. Use when credibility, permissions or AI policy constrain the engagement.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划如何赢得客户信任并拿到恰当授权
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在客户合作中因信任或授权问题推进受阻
copy.tagline_en: Plan how to win client trust and secure the right access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if trust or access issues are blocking a client engagement

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在调查或行动前先读任务上下文契约与方法文档，在客户许可的范围内规划如何赢得客户信任、拿到合适的权限，并如实报告缺失的能力或未运行的检查。
howto.when: 当可信度、权限或 AI 政策限制这次合作时触发；由 @fde 调用时复用其当前的净化数据包与范围，不重新开始设置或提问。

say.text: 我们的 AI 政策限制了这次合作，先规划怎么赢得客户信任。
say.note: 先读上下文契约，再给出信任规划。

say.text: 客户只开放了部分仓库权限，按这个范围来推进。
say.note: 把规划限制在已获许可的范围内。

say.text: @fde 已经给了净化后的数据包，直接沿用，别重来。
say.note: 跳过设置和已答过的问题。

howto.what_en: After install, before investigating or acting, Claude reads the task context contract and the earn-trust method, then plans how to earn customer trust and appropriate access within the permitted scope, and reports missing capabilities or unrun checks honestly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when credibility, permissions or AI policy constrain the engagement. If invoked by @fde, it reuses its current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or discovery.

say_en.text: Our AI policy limits this engagement — plan how we earn customer trust first.
say_en.note: Reads the context contract, then drafts the trust plan.

say_en.text: The customer granted only partial repo access; stay within that scope.
say_en.note: Keeps the plan inside the permitted access.

say_en.text: @fde already sent a sanitized packet — reuse it, don't restart.
